landmarks.note: Projection agreement under the supplied camera; does not independently establish physical dimensions.

silhouette.reason: Provide a fixed reference subject mask and a rendered subject-only binary mask.

camera_check.note: Image extent alone cannot distinguish camera error from model error. Compare independent correspondences before changing either.

photographic.note: Only fixed observations and explicit masks control this assessment. A threshold miss is not an instruction to repeat; refine only when evidence and expected benefit justify another pass.

appearance.note: Automated linkage/geometry/material checks, not visual acceptance or colour accuracy.

visual_review.basis: Inspected full 1920x1285 comparison and oblique draft. Main facade proportions, 11-bay rhythm, portico silhouette, roof balustrade and viewpoint are consistent with source. Carved detail and landscaping are simplified; illumination is flatter and cooler, entrance fanlight joinery approximate, and missing left tree changes occlusion. Scale and rear geometry are assumptions. This is a useful exterior reconstruction, not a photoreal or surveyed replica.

note: Visual acceptance never changes an automated check. Agent visual review is not user acceptance.
limitations: No independent held-out landmarks. All 11 were consumed for fitting.
Silhouette overlap was not measured; source envelope is partly hidden by vegetation.
Automated appearance check verifies IFC geometry/material linkage, not photographic colour or ornament accuracy.
stopping_reason: Primary exterior, semantic export and fixed-landmark accuracy achieved. Further historical detail and hidden geometry are unsupported by the single photograph; ornamental and landscaping refinements are disproportionate to the available evidence.
